provenance: The owner, 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-08 (docs/review/signal-symbols-worklist.md, Rulings 2026-11-08: train order boards): a train order lever has the inputs STOP and SLOW; nothing asserted shows the rest word CLEAR; otherwise the highest-ranked asserted input wins (FieldUnit ADR 0010 D1, D2). CALLON is the block signal's indication, not a train order control. The words are indications, never a colour or a blade angle.
